decisions.decision: Hi-Fi image is for human visual review only; exclude from Codex implementation context

All Codex implementation requires a human-approved scoped Child Issue under an approved Umbrella in the active provider (GitHub or GitLab), or explicit equivalent bounded Human instruction; no autonomous merge.
decisions.note: v0.0.7 restates historical GitHub-only wording in provider-neutral form.

decisions.decision: Labels are a first-class classification for engineering work; labels must not substitute Human approval.
Engineering management remains portable between GitHub and GitLab, using persistent canonical local work IDs with verified provider bindings.
COMPLAIN.md is the internal engineering operations complaint register; complaints are not execution authorization and require Human triage before escalation.
